meta.vehicle: BMW X4 M40i F26 (N55), DME via BimmerLink over ENET
meta.source: Header of BimmerLink all-parameters CSV 2026-08-09_15-12-47.csv (210 columns, CSV order); plus index 211, a label that later logs carry and the all-parameters CSV does not

fields.index: 1-based column position in the all-parameters CSV (labels may be reordered in smaller logs: match on label)
fields.label: Exact BimmerLink column label
fields.key: snake_case identifier for code; duplicates suffixed _2
fields.unit: Typical unit; BimmerLink may display another scale, so verify against a log
fields.role: core = primary analysis channel | standard = useful context | flag = 0/1 or status | counter = event count | raw = sensor voltage/raw value where a physical value exists | redundant = duplicate of another channel | static = adaptation/diagnostic value that rarely moves | broken = unusable on this car
fields.confidence: high = established meaning | medium = meaning clear, exact definition or scaling uncertain | low = machine-translated label, best interpretation
fields.presets: Log presets from the project doc (1b = fine-misfire variant of preset 1)

parameters.label: ADC voltage Lambda probe behind catalytic converter
parameters.description: Signal voltage of the downstream (post-cat) narrowband O2 sensor. ~0.1 V lean, ~0.8 V rich; a steady value means the cat is storing oxygen.
parameters.note: Preferred downstream channel (refresh ~1.3/s).

parameters.label: Accepted generator torque
parameters.description: Alternator drag torque accepted by the DME into its torque model.

parameters.label: Actual gear
parameters.description: Gear currently engaged, as known by the DME.

parameters.label: Actual gear information from the gear sensor
parameters.description: Gear information straight from the transmission gear/selector sensor.
parameters.note: Duplicate of Actual gear for most uses.

parameters.label: Actual ignition angle
parameters.description: Actual spark advance (degrees before TDC). Drops when the DME retards for knock or torque reduction.

parameters.label: Actual inlet spread
parameters.description: Measured intake camshaft position (VANOS spread) relative to the crankshaft.

parameters.label: Actual oil pressure value (absolute pressure)
parameters.description: Measured engine oil pressure, absolute (includes ~1 bar atmospheric).

parameters.label: Actual operating mode
parameters.description: Current DME combustion/operating mode (e.g. normal homogeneous, catalyst heating).
parameters.note: Enum codes not documented; useful to split cold-start phases.

parameters.label: Actual operating mode, oil pressure control
parameters.description: Current stage of the map-controlled oil pump (low / high pressure stage).

parameters.label: Actual speed electr. water pump
parameters.description: Measured speed of the electric coolant pump.

parameters.label: Actual value exhaust spread BMW
parameters.description: Measured exhaust camshaft position (BMW spread definition).
parameters.note: Compare with Target angle camshaft exhaust closes.

parameters.label: Actual value intake spread BMW
parameters.description: Measured intake camshaft position (BMW spread definition).
parameters.note: Compare with Target angle (inlet VANOS).

parameters.label: Actual value of the eccentric angle VVT
parameters.description: Measured Valvetronic eccentric-shaft angle, which sets intake valve lift.
parameters.note: Compare with Setpoint eccentric angle VVT (135808).

parameters.label: Actual value of the outlet spread
parameters.description: Measured exhaust camshaft spread (alternative definition).

parameters.label: Adjustment of throttle valve model (factor)
parameters.description: Learned multiplicative correction of the throttle air-flow model (≈1.0 when nominal).
parameters.note: Drifts with throttle carbon build-up or air leaks.

parameters.label: Adjustment of throttle valve model (offset)
parameters.description: Learned additive offset correction of the throttle air-flow model.
parameters.note: A large offset can point to an unmetered air leak.

parameters.label: Adjustment range of the eccentric angle
parameters.description: Learned Valvetronic eccentric-shaft travel between its end stops.

parameters.label: Air damper - actual position in degrees
parameters.description: Active grille shutter, actual position (degrees).

parameters.label: Air damper - actual position in steps
parameters.description: Active grille shutter, actual position (motor steps).

parameters.label: Air damper - target position in degrees
parameters.description: Active grille shutter, target position (degrees).

parameters.label: Air damper - target position in steps
parameters.description: Active grille shutter, target position (motor steps).

parameters.label: Air flap - lower air flap status
parameters.description: Status of the lower active grille flap.

parameters.label: Air flap - upper air flap status
parameters.description: Status of the upper active grille flap.

parameters.label: Air mass flow
parameters.description: Engine air mass flow as calculated by the DME (main load signal).

parameters.label: Air mass flow HFM, corrected and filtered (for calculation of control difference mass flow controller)
parameters.description: Corrected and filtered MAF (HFM) value used by the mass-flow controller diagnosis.
parameters.note: The N55 normally has no physical MAF; may be modelled or static. Check in a log.

parameters.label: Air mass flow filtered
parameters.description: Filtered version of Air mass flow.

parameters.label: Ambient pressure
parameters.description: Barometric pressure used by the DME.
parameters.note: Baseline for boost/vacuum calculations.

parameters.label: Ambient pressure from sensor
parameters.description: Barometric pressure read from the sensor inside the DME.

parameters.label: Ambient pressure sensor voltage (10-bit from ADC)
parameters.description: Raw ADC reading of the barometric sensor.

parameters.label: Ambient temperature
parameters.description: Outside air temperature.
parameters.note: Good context tag for each log.

parameters.label: Angle inlet valve opens based on LWOT
parameters.description: Intake-valve opening angle relative to gas-exchange TDC (LWOT).
parameters.note: Results from VANOS position.

parameters.label: Average angle of rotation of the camshaft
parameters.description: Averaged camshaft angle measurement (cam/crank correlation).

parameters.label: Average of the measured values for mass flow diagnosis HFM in the LL
parameters.description: Idle (LL) average from the MAF plausibility diagnosis.
parameters.note: Probably only updates during the diagnostic run.

parameters.label: Boost pressure
parameters.description: Measured charge pressure upstream of the throttle (absolute).
parameters.note: Subtract ambient pressure for gauge boost.

parameters.label: Boost pressure from the sensor as an average
parameters.description: Averaged boost sensor reading.

parameters.label: Boost pressure raw value
parameters.description: Unfiltered boost sensor value.
parameters.note: Faster than the filtered value for lift-off analysis.

parameters.label: Boost pressure setpoint
parameters.description: Boost pressure target requested by the DME.

parameters.label: Clutch motor torque actual value
parameters.description: Actual engine torque at the crankshaft/clutch after losses.

parameters.label: Condition Level measurement error from the oil condition sensor
parameters.description: Flag: the oil condition/level sensor reports a measurement error.

parameters.label: Condition Vanos entrance at the ready
parameters.description: Flag: intake VANOS released and ready to control (after oil pressure builds).

parameters.label: Condition The probe behind the catalyst is sufficiently heated
parameters.description: Flag: downstream O2 sensor has reached operating temperature.
parameters.note: Filter downstream-sensor analysis on this.

parameters.label: Condition for detected knockers
parameters.description: Flag: knock detected (any cylinder).

parameters.label: Condition exhaust flap with resonator
parameters.description: Exhaust flap state (open/closed).

parameters.label: Condition oil sensor failure
parameters.description: Flag: oil condition sensor fault.

parameters.label: Condition probe ready for operation before cat
parameters.description: Flag: upstream wideband sensor ready, so closed-loop lambda control is possible.
parameters.note: Use to split open loop from closed loop.

parameters.label: Condition probe ready for operation behind cat
parameters.description: Flag: downstream sensor ready for operation.

parameters.label: Condition start request
parameters.description: Flag: engine start requested (start button or auto start-stop restart).

parameters.label: Condition super knocker
parameters.description: Flag: pre-ignition (super knock / LSPI) detected.

parameters.label: Confirmed target speed electr. water pump
parameters.description: Speed command acknowledged by the electric coolant pump.

parameters.label: Control unit temperature
parameters.description: Internal temperature of the DME.

parameters.label: Control difference boost pressure - bank-specific bank 1
parameters.description: Boost control error (setpoint minus actual).
parameters.note: Persistent positive value = underboost.

parameters.label: Coolant temperature
parameters.description: Engine coolant temperature.

parameters.label: Coolant temperature (sensor value) after low-pass filtering
parameters.description: Low-pass filtered coolant temperature.

parameters.label: Coordinated moment for filling
parameters.description: Torque request handed to the air path (slow, charge-based torque path).
parameters.note: Gap vs. actual torque shows when the air path lags.

parameters.label: Correction factor for the amount of fuel
parameters.description: Overall multiplicative correction applied to injected fuel quantity.

parameters.label: Correction factor height
parameters.description: Altitude correction factor.

parameters.label: Correction value of the LSU voltage before CAT
parameters.description: Learned offset correction of the upstream wideband (Bosch LSU) sensor voltage.
parameters.note: Large values suggest an ageing upstream sensor.

parameters.label: Correction value shutdown
parameters.description: Correction value learned at engine shutdown (purpose unclear).

parameters.label: Crankshaft adaptation exhaust takes place
parameters.description: Flag: exhaust cam/crank reference adaptation in progress.

parameters.label: Crankshaft adaptation intake takes place
parameters.description: Flag: intake cam/crank reference adaptation in progress.

parameters.label: Cross slope (estimated) in degrees
parameters.description: Estimated lateral (side) slope of the car.
parameters.note: Affects oil level readings.

parameters.label: Degree of utilization generator 1
parameters.description: Alternator load (field duty).

parameters.label: Delta probe offset master control
parameters.description: Trim correction from the downstream sensor applied to upstream lambda control.
parameters.note: Drifting value points to upstream sensor or cat ageing.

parameters.label: Difference between ambient pressure and brake booster pressure from pressure sensor (raw value)
parameters.description: Brake booster vacuum (ambient minus booster pressure), raw.
parameters.note: Booster/vacuum-pump health.

parameters.label: Differential pressure in front of the throttle valve between the start and the end of the dynamic test SSP
parameters.description: Result of a dynamic plausibility test on the pre-throttle pressure sensor.
parameters.note: Only changes when the test runs.

parameters.label: Engine oil level
parameters.description: Oil level from the oil condition sensor.
parameters.note: Unit/scale to confirm against the dipstick.

parameters.label: Engine speed
parameters.description: Engine speed.
parameters.note: Master time-base parameter for almost every preset.

parameters.label: Electric Fuel Pump
parameters.description: Command/state of the in-tank low-pressure fuel pump (EKP).

parameters.label: Effective engine power
parameters.description: Calculated current engine power output.

parameters.label: Engine starting temperature

parameters.label: Exhaust camshaft position

parameters.label: Exhaust gas temperature according to KAT from model

parameters.label: Exhaust gas temperature behind main catalyst from model
